From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Planned: us-east3 rolling capacity handoff (Jul 2) — brief customer notice

Hi Jordan / CloudScale Ops team,

Quick note to let you know we'll be performing a controlled capacity handoff in the us-east3 region on Saturday, Jul 2 between 02:00–05:00 UTC. This operation is a rolling swap of a subset of inference host drivers to enable a new kernel/IO driver combination that improves throughput for long-context models. Key points: 

- Window: 2027-07-02 02:00–05:00 UTC.
- Expected customer impact: transient TCP resets and short-lived RPC retries (most customers will see no visible interruption; a small percentage of long-lived streaming sessions may briefly reconnect — typical reconnect time ~30–90s).
- Scope: ~15% of capacity in us-east3 (non-DEDICATED pools excluded unless explicitly listed on your contract).
- Rollback: immediate rollback plan in place; we will pause the roll if error rate > 2% for > 5 minutes.

Action for CloudScale: no action required unless you run pinned dedicated instances in us-east3 (email me and we'll exclude those). If you'd like us to schedule a blackout for critical jobs, let us know window and we'll exempt.

Attachments: runbook (us-east3-capacity-handoff-runbook.pdf) with step-by-step operator checks and expected metrics. Status page link below will be updated during the operation.

Status: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2027-07-us-east3-handoff

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Regional Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Neha — appreciate the heads up. Two quick Qs: 

1) Will any dedicated capacity customers be impacted implicitly (we have a pool of reserved capacity pinned to us-east3).
2) Can you confirm whether in-flight streaming completions (server-sent events) will resume automatically or if we need to restart client streams?

If there is anything we need to toggle on our side we'll follow your guidance.

— Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the questions. Short answers below and copied the on-call ops folks to ensure we have a synchronous SLA channel during the window.

1) Dedicated capacity: your reserved pools are excluded by default. If you have a contract-level exception (older committed pools), please flag me; otherwise no change.

2) In-flight streams: most client streams will auto-reconnect — our gateway sends a final "retryable" error before eviction. For long-running SSE connections we recommend clients implement exponential backoff reconnect; typical resume time is under 90s. If you rely on exactly-once semantics for streaming, let us know and we'll add a temporary traffic pin/blackout for your sessions.

We'll update the status page at each major milestone; karthik will be monitoring metrics and can trigger an immediate halt if error rates rise.

Cheers,
Neha

Subject: Post-maintenance: us-east3 capacity handoff — brief summary and next steps

Hi Jordan / Team —

Thanks again for the coordination. Summary and follow-ups from the Jul 2 handoff: 

- Outcome: Rolling handoff completed successfully across targeted host groups between 02:04–03:47 UTC. No rollback required.
- Customer impact observed: a peak of 1.2% retry rate for streaming RPCs during host group swaps; 0.03% of active sessions observed a reconnect longer than 3 minutes. No data loss or request duplication detected.
- Root cause notes: reconnects were primarily due to a timing edge in the gateway's client close notification while the host was being drained. The kernel/driver combo performed as expected after swap.

Immediate action items (owner / ETA):
- Adjust gateway drain grace period from 45s -> 120s to give clients additional time to drain gracefully (owner: monica_patel / ETA: 2027-07-09).
- Add a streaming resume test to the nightly chaos suite to catch this edge (owner: marissa_cole / ETA: 2027-07-07).
- Publish a short SDK guidance note on recommended reconnect backoff for long SSE/streaming sessions (owner: neha_kapoor / ETA: 2027-07-06).

Attachments: postmortem-us-east3-handoff-summary.docx (internal) — includes metric graphs, timeline and raw operator logs. Public summary posted on status page.

If you'd like us to schedule a dedicated blackout for your critical jobs in a future maintenance window while we make the gateway change, let me know what times suit you and we will prioritize.

Appreciate the patience — happy to walk through the postmortem with your team if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Regional Operations
Redwood Inference
